game_concept: A action defense set in Snowy Hold – Aurora Terrace, a terrace under the aurora: the snow ranger must handle snow wraiths while practicing functions. Core idea – Keyword Switchboard: Call functions with keyword arguments to wire the right switches.
theme: Snowy Hold – Aurora Terrace: a terrace under the aurora
core_gameplay_loop: In Aurora Terrace, repeat each round: Call functions with keyword arguments to wire the right switches. Each round, snow wraiths strike the larder door, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the wires value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Protect the larder door from snow wraiths in Aurora Terrace: keep the wires meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 33-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: wires drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 33-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 2 (intro tier): Keyword Switchboard
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how wires changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against snow wraiths in Aurora Terrace.
